info.title: Robotics Expert Course Platform API
info.summary: Curriculum content, learner progress and reports over HTTP.

get.description: Readiness: the curriculum is indexed and the progress store opens.

schema.title: Response List Courses Api V1 Courses Get

get.description: One course with its modules grouped by level (consecutive modules of one level).
One module with its lessons in teaching order.
Lesson metadata, Markdown body, resources, and the study-method section.
Resources of every lesson in teaching order, merged by (title, url).

schema.title: Response List Resources Api V1 Resources Get

get.description: Every lesson's progress in teaching order, plus the running timer (``rc status``).
Lessons whose prerequisites are done: in-progress first, then teaching order.

schema.title: Response Get Next Api V1 Progress Next Get

get.description: Progress of every lesson in teaching order (``not_started`` when never touched).

schema.title: Response List Lesson Progress Api V1 Progress Lessons Get

post.description: Start a study timer (one at a time; 409 if one is running).
Stop the running timer and add its time; ``discard`` drops it (409 if none runs).
Record study time manually: a session of ``minutes`` ending now.
Mark a lesson done (stops its running timer); lists the lessons it unlocked.

get.description:
Weekly report (``rc report weekly``): time, completions, stuck points, next lessons.

Weeks run Monday to Sunday in the server's local timezone.
Per-module report (``rc report module``): lesson table, understanding distribution.
All progress rows and sessions: the same JSON as ``rc progress export``.

Activity.title: Activity
Activity.description: One unit of learner work inside a lesson.

ActivityProgress.title: ActivityProgress
ActivityProgress.description: Per-activity state (platform-design §4.1); Phase 1 only records quiz activities.

Card.title: Card
Card.description: A flashcard made from a quiz question (FR-4.2); id is ``<lesson>-<source>-<qid>``.

CardState.title: CardState
CardState.description: SM-2 scheduling state of one card for one user (FR-4.3).

stages.title: Stages
stages.description: Modules grouped by level, in course order.

study_method.title: Study Method
study_method.description: Markdown of the "## 이 단계 공부법" section, if the lesson has one.

locked.title: Locked
locked.description: Some prerequisite is not done yet.

LessonState.title: LessonState
LessonState.description: One lesson in teaching order with its progress (a row of ``rc status``).

ProgressExport.title: ProgressExport
ProgressExport.description:
JSON document produced by ``rc progress export`` (FR-10.2).

Lists added in schema version 2 default to empty, so a version-1 export still imports.

QuizAttempt.title: QuizAttempt
QuizAttempt.description: One answered question of a quiz run.

QuizRun.title: QuizRun
QuizRun.description: A completed ``rc quiz`` session: score and timing (AC-4.2).

markdown.title: Markdown
markdown.description: The same Markdown as `rc report weekly|module`.

Resource.title: Resource
Resource.description: A study resource as written in lesson front matter.

Session.title: Session
Session.description: One study session: a timer run (``rc start``/``rc stop``) or a manual log.

level.title: Level
level.description: null for modules without a level.

seconds.title: Seconds
seconds.description: Elapsed seconds (0 while running or when discarded).

loc.description: Where the bad value is, e.g. ['body', 'minutes'].
loc.title: Loc

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem details. ``type`` is ``about:blank`` and ``title`` the HTTP phrase.
Problem.title: Problem
